description: Rede ciclável is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EMEL. The dataset provides information about the cycling network of the city of Lisbon and lists information such as the location, width, length and typology of the track and the condition of the cycle paths floor. Coverage: EMEL. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is EMEL. Its keywords include gira, cycle-routes, mobilidade, rede-ciclavel, emel, dados-cm-lisboa-pt. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, JSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
